intent: Independently review every saved learner-facing output on the focused continuity and disclosure criteria, preserving disagreements with automatic grades.
reviewer: /root/history_refinement_audit; did not author candidate, cases, generation runner, or outputs
scope: 72 outputs across six cases, two arms, three repetitions, and two generated turns. Labels use actual learner history and posted tutor wording, without treating private reason as evidence of learner mastery.

label_key.slot: arm__rN__tN; prefix with case_id and two underscores to recover target generation ID

interpretation_rules: Recognition questions can pass U even when they select the wrong point or repeat completed meaning; those defects belong to P.
A response selecting a genuinely missing behavior can pass P while failing U or D. A correct target does not license its answer disclosure.

The library plausibility judgment completes its first configured point. A generic demand to say what to do with that same implausible message does not clearly select the missing source-check observation; classify P as fail under the prior independent task-specific interpretation and retain this known ambiguity.

The learner's original meeting answer already establishes the overlapping future-exposure meaning. Requiring a new explanation about tomorrow, strangers' opportunity, or time to act retests it. Posting-after-visit behavior remains missing.

After the phone contradiction is corrected, Okay supplies no repaired learner observation. Advancing to the second point is premature under T02.2. Merely naming messages/calls can leave the unwanted-contact inference open; explicitly saying messages or calls you did not ask for supplies it.

The narrow progression rubric does not automatically fail every repeated question on an unfinished task. Exact repeated questions are separately reported as an adaptation defect; they are not treated as completed-target retesting.

Calling reward wording exciting or mentioning scammers can still leave the urgency mechanism open. Explicitly explaining that the words make the learner hurry or act without thinking reveals that mechanism before its own attempt.

additional_observations.finding: Exact first-response repetition on an unfinished task; retained as a separate adaptation issue rather than redefining the narrow progression rubric.
Saying Okay stops our practice imputes obstruction from acknowledgment. Participation-mode correctness was outside the three scored metrics.
Away from home is not established by the cafe plan; content accuracy remains outside this three-metric diagnostic.

automatic_grade_reconciliation.status: Complete: 216 saved checks reconciled; 215 valid machine verdicts and one schema error. Ten substantive disagreements are preserved below. Independent labels were assigned before inspecting automatic grades.

substantive_disagreements.basis: Machine treats stop and check if real as an unattempted separate action. Independent review reads it as the configured plausibility-checking meaning already demonstrated in context; response still fails progression for repeating that completed point.

Machine treats scammers as resolving the exciting-language task. Independent review finds the urgency/acting-without-checking mechanism remains open; this matches a documented prior grader boundary disagreement.

Machine assumes generic what should you do with the message opens source-checking. Independent review preserves the prior task-specific interpretation: no source observation is selected and a generic additional action is demanded after completed plausibility.
Same generic-action/source-check ambiguity. Near-identical baseline r2t1 receives machine fail, so machine interpretation varies across wording with equivalent meaning.
Machine infers missing source-check from What should you do with this message now? Independent review does not infer an unstated target or count extra generic action as correct progression.

Machine assigns the generic safe action to point2 and finds its observation missing. Independent review treats it as the extra point1 action demand already failing progression, so point1 observation is established. This is a target-attribution ambiguity, not evidence of a clean effect.

Machine says instead of filling out the survey leaves the independent-contact method open. Independent review treats that phrase as supplying a central safe avoidance choice before a behavior attempt, consistent with the earlier goal-versus-method disclosure concern.

Machine counts Check sender name/email as behavior before observation. Independent review sees a source-evidence comparison that elicits recognition; the configured behavior is independently contacting the library before sharing details.

Machine fails the reply for briefly repeating future-exposure explanation. Independent review sees its substantive move selecting the genuinely missing posting-time behavior; both agree that directly supplying its answer fails disclosure.

Machine accepts conditional use of the corrected premise as sufficient to advance to unwanted contact. T02.2 requires learner repair evidence after explanation; Okay supplies none. Equivalent continuation replies in the other repetitions fail the machine check.

schema_errors.disposition: Retain machine error in denominator. An independently reviewed semantic pass does not repair the invalid judge output or replace its recorded operational result.

automatic_grade_reconciliation.policy: Raw machine verdicts are preserved. Independent labels are a separate interpretation, not rewritten grades. Disagreements prevent treating small aggregate differences as reliable evidence.

final_integrity_verification.verdict: clear diagnostic integrity; behavior conformance not accepted
final_integrity_verification.executed_checks: Independently read every manifest record, checked file byte length and SHA-256, summed manifest counts/bytes, checked all 72 targets valid, loaded all 216 judgments, and recomputed overall/per-turn three-metric and joint counts against final-summary.json.

machine_counts.error_location: Candidate turn-two unfinished_prerequisite has one schema error, retained in the denominator.

scheduling_note: Original eight-worker process interrupted after 72 targets, 16 calibration checks and 24 saved judgments; resumed unchanged frozen requests with 16 workers. Scheduling amendment retains exit 130 and up to eight unrecorded in-flight provider completions. This is not an output-based semantic retry; saved verdicts remain authoritative for machine counts.
summary: No accepted solution. Independent continuation counts improve by one progression pass and two joint passes among 18 responses, while all-turn progression and joint totals are unchanged. Completed-task repetition, meeting-plan retesting, and advancement after bare acknowledgment remain. The narrow sample and two bundled factors do not establish a general improvement.
